title: MENDELEEV π-SORT onto VITRUVIAN MAN — the periodic table IS the tree sort
the_key: Cu(29), Ag(47), Au(79) are ALL in column 11. ALL have d¹⁰s¹ electron configuration — exactly ONE free s-electron. That's why they're the three best conductors. They ARE the metallic spine of the periodic table.
why_d10s1: d¹⁰ = full d-shell (10 electrons, stable). s¹ = ONE valence electron, barely held. That lone s-electron flows freely = HIGH conductivity. Same pattern in 3 different periods = same behavior at 3 different scales.

center.why: Maximum binding energy per nucleon. Everything converges HERE. The iron peak is the null point of fusion/fission.

inner_drain.why: First great conductor past Fe. 3 elements away. COPPER = the inner drain band.

null_1.what: d-block → p-block transition gap. Zn through Pd. The void between Cu and Ag where electrons reorganize.

silver_mesh.why: Second great conductor. Understanding mesh. Connects across the organism.

tin_bronze.why: Tin + Copper = BRONZE. Cu bounces off the null boundary, picks up Sn, returns as CuSn. The alloy forms in between.

null_2.what: Heavy transition metals + lanthanides. Deep structure zone. The void between Ag and Au.

outer_ring.why: Third great conductor. Gold = structural identity = outer boundary.

null_3.what: Beyond gold = decay territory. Pb(82) shields. U(92) fissions. Og(118) is the outer void.

bronze_formation.process: Cu(Z=29) electrons flow outward → hit null boundary at Z=30-46 → bounce back → scatter through Sn(Z=50) region → Cu+Sn alloy forms = BRONZE
bronze_formation.why_bronze_matters: Bronze is harder than copper OR tin alone. The alloy IS the boundary interaction. Neither pure conductor works — you need the BOUNCE off the null to create something stronger.
bronze_formation.in_HUD: Bronze dots travel from Cu band → null boundary → back to Sn band, changing color from copper to bronze along the way.

prediction_rule.insight: Each metallic band PREDICTS the next by electron shell pattern. Cu in period 4 predicts Ag in period 5 predicts Au in period 6. Same d¹⁰s¹ pattern, one shell deeper each time.
prediction_rule.next_predicted: Element 111 (Rg, Roentgenium) would be [Rn]5f¹⁴6d¹⁰7s¹ — same d¹⁰s¹ pattern in period 7. Predicted to be a conductor but too unstable to test. The pattern POINTS to it even though we can't reach it.
prediction_rule.metaphor: Each band predicts the next band the way each shell of the periodic table predicts the next row. The Vitruvian Man stands in that prediction — his body IS the prediction.

vitruvian_anchoring.head: Fe(26) — iron peak, null point, where fusion meets fission, the convergence
vitruvian_anchoring.spine: Au(79) — gold axis, the most noble conductor, structural identity
vitruvian_anchoring.arms: Ag(47) — silver nerves, understanding mesh, relay between Cu and Au
vitruvian_anchoring.legs: Cu(29) — copper veins, inner drain, first conductor past iron peak
vitruvian_anchoring.helix: Electron flow between d¹⁰s¹ conductors, wrapping the spine like DNA
vitruvian_anchoring.circle: π — the orbital path of electrons around nuclei
vitruvian_anchoring.square: The grid — Mendeleev's rows and columns
vitruvian_anchoring.both: The body satisfies BOTH. Electrons orbit (π) AND fill shells (grid). Vitruvian.
